note: Kittson County (27069) parcels are published only through the county's Schneider Beacon viewer, which is not a public ArcGIS REST or file service (the viewer returned a 403 bot-check page to our reads). The state's compiled opt-in parcel layer (plan_parcels_open, 2.7M features) has zero records for Kittson (co_name and co_code 27069 queries both return 0). Commercial vendors (Dynamo, Rockford, Mapping Solutions, Regrid) sell the data but offer no free service.
